closest.text:
About Us

Observe.AI is the AI Agents platform for customer experience, designed to help organizations deliver faster, smarter, and more efficient customer service at scale. The platform enables businesses to deploy specialized AI agents that autonomously execute work across the full CX lifecycle—from handling customer conversations to supporting frontline teams and optimizing operations.

Each AI agent is purpose-built for a specific role, equipped to understand context, make decisions, take action, and continuously improve outcomes. This allows organizations to increase resolution speed, elevate service quality, and reduce operational costs while empowering your frontline team to focus on higher-value work.

Built on a CX-native foundation, Observe.AI helps leading brands like DoorDash, Affordable Care, Signify Health, and Verida improve customer satisfaction, boost agent productivity, and deliver consistent, scalable performance across every customer interaction.

Why Join Us

At Observe, you’ll play a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer and product experience. This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, problem-solving, and customer impact—owning issues end-to-end and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to drive resolution.

You’ll gain hands-on exposure to real-world technical challenges, contribute to pre-release testing and product quality, and help shape customer-facing documentation and training materials. Beyond the day-to-day work, this role offers strong career growth, meaningful ownership, and the chance to grow alongside a fast-scaling organization—backed by competitive compensation and benefits typically found in larger, established companies.

What you’ll be doing

  • Front-end all customer-reported issues.
  • Review, identify, and help troubleshoot issues reported by the customers within the agreed SLA.
  • Manage customer expectations and be the point of contact for all customer service issues.
  • Proactively identify, diagnose, analyze, and troubleshoot the issues on the Observe.AI platform.
  • Research alternative solutions or workarounds.
  • Appropriately escalate issues internally and own them end-to-end till resolution.
  • Implement regular upgrades to the tools and proactively monitor the platform.
  • Document the issues and solutions and contribute to the knowledge base by recording internal and customer-facing videos. For example, help write SOPs, service notes, and troubleshooting documents.
  • Learn new features, technologies, and become an SME of the platform

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Bachelor’s degree required with major in a technical field preferred (e.g., Engineering); or an advanced degree is a plus.
  • 1+ years’ experience in a similar role.
  • Solid technical background, with a demonstrable understanding of AI and machine learning.
  • SaaS experience is essential.
  • Python/scripting experience is an added advantage.
  • Should have worked on tools like Zendesk, Confluence, JIRA, etc.
  • Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Perks & Benefits
  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for self and family, including free online doctor consultations and additional wellness benefits
  • Accidental insurance and group term life insurance coverage
  • Privilege and sick leave in line with applicable statutory norms
  • Generous national and festive holidays, along with well-defined parental leave policies
  • Annual Learning & Development allowance to support continuous professional growth
  • Rewards and recognition programs designed to encourage and celebrate high performance
  • Regular team and culture-building events across the organization
  • Flexible benefits for tax optimisation, including meal cards, provident fund, and other options

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Observe.AI also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

We welcome all people. We celebrate diversity of all kinds and are committed to creating an inclusive culture built on a foundation of respect for all individuals. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. Individuals from non-traditional backgrounds, historically marginalized or underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and you're ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply. For more information, visit www.observe.ai.

OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.


The Opportunity

As a Software Developer, your mission will be to use latest technology to develop complex module/component design, automate and maintain an efficient, flexible, and fault-tolerant cloud solutions. You should be highly motivated and talented engineer with a strong desire to learn and grow your skills in developing the solutions for cloud offerings and deployment. You will be responsible for all aspects of the development, load balancing and disaster recovery etc. and work continuously with cloud solutions.

You are good at:

  • Should be able to independently develop complex software
  • Takes ownership of code quality. Actively and effectively reviews source code, takes defect prevention steps in software developed.
  • Interacts well with peers and communicates in a clear and concise manner both verbally and written on his/her work.
  • Actively participate and contribute to analysis, design, planning, processes, etc., Raise issues where needed and create sensitivity towards timely resolution of problems.
  • Adopt agile development methodologies and test-driven development.

What it takes:

  • Should have 3 to 5 years of enterprise product development experience
  • Should have strong hands-on experience in Java technologies
  • Should have very good problem solving, analytical, design and coding skills
  • Programming and Scripting Languages (Java)
  • Experience on Spring and Hibernate
  • Exposure on building and consuming webservices (using RESTful APIs)
  • SQL, Databases, data modeling
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies.

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

closest.text: Software engineer - Real-Time Pricing Skip to menu Skip to search Skip to main content Skip to footer Menu Back to Technology jobs in Amsterdam Software engineer - Real-Time Pricing Level Experienced Location Amsterdam Department Technology Apply Apply Optiver is looking for a software engineer to join our real-time pricing systems team. Team builds and runs the highly reliable, traceable and scalable pricing platform responsible for automated real-time pricing of millions of derivative contracts listed on 70+ exchanges. We continuously need to react to the new low latency pricing signals and instruct our execution to update our prices in all affected instruments. At the same time we need to continuously produce large volumes of various pricing datasets allowing us to trade, analyze and breakdown our trade quality, visualize and understand our positions, run automation, systematic analysis and trading strategies. All of this while allowing for a rapid development and pricing model research cycle with multiple releases per day. What you’ll do: Work directly with trading, researchers and other development teams in tightly knit working groups being responsible for overall success of the projects. We are not afraid of crossing team boundaries, learn about each other’s domain and apply this expertise in practice. Apply your engineering background to translate business problems into robust, production grade software Work on our pricing platform - already a key competitive advantage - while helping push it even further by: optimizing our low-latency data processing optimizing our large scale compute distribution of large volume datasets across multiple physical locations while ensuring consistency and atomicity increasing automation to further reduce our time to market Have a direct impact on business with a tight feedback loop Join a strong and dynamic team Who you are: A software engineer with an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to strategically identify the tools which are best placed and where time is best spent, to achieve the results needed for our business to continue performing at the highest possible level. Experience designing and building large-scale, distributed or real-time systems Strong software engineering fundamentals and an interest in writing reliable, maintainable production code Ability to operate autonomously as well as collaborate with Traders, Researchers, other technical teams and business operations counterparts to deliver on complex business initiatives Experience with C++ is a plus Interest in systematic trading, derivatives pricing, or quantitative finance more broadly is a strong plus - but not a hard requirement; we will teach you what you need to know What you'll get : You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets. In addition, you’ll receive: A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool. The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 40 different countries. 25 paid vacation days and fully paid first-class commuting expenses. Training opportunities and discounts on health insurance. Extensive office perks, including breakfast and lunch, world-class barista coffee, sports and leisure activities, Friday afternoon drinks, and weekly in-house chair massages. Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats. Who we are: At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe. How to apply: Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe? Apply directly via the form below for the position of Core Software Engineer. If you are selected from your application to proceed to the next round for the position of Core Software Engineer, you will be required to take an online assessment. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form . Please note: We cannot accept applications via email for data protection reasons. We do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. DIVERSITY STATEMENT: Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion . AI Engineer 

Experience: 3–8 years (minimum 2 years in AI applications) 
Location: Hyderabad 
Work Timing: 11 am – 8 pm

  • Follow SDLC practices

You will own design and solution of Ozonetel’s most complex, high-value enterprise deployments — designing systems that are scalable, resilient, and tightly aligned with each customer’s long-term AI strategy. Where a Forward Deployment Engineer builds and deploys, you design the blueprint. Understand business requirements and map them into product and AI workflows. Guide internal teams on how AI-enabled workflows, copilots, assistants, and prompt-driven experiences should be designed and delivered. Support solution demos, workshops, customer discussions, and executive presentations when required. Define integration patterns, API design standards, and data flow architectures for enterprise customers with complex environments. Produce detailed architecture documents, solution design reviews, and technical proposals for strategic accounts. Evaluate customer infrastructure (cloud, on-prem, hybrid) and recommend deployment models that balance performance, security, and cost. Own technical risk assessment for every major deployment — identify gaps before go-live, not after. Document solution and complex use cases that extend Ozonetel’s internal knowledge base. Strong prior experience with AI/NLP integrations — chatbots, voice bots, sentiment analysis, or real-time transcription. Exceptional communication skills — you can present a complex solution to a board and explain an API payload to a junior developer with equal clarity. Strong problem-solving mindset with both technical depth and business orientation Good to Have Background in cloud telephony, VoIP, SIP, WebRTC, or contact center platforms (CCaaS). Experience in regulated industries: BFSI, healthcare, or government technology.

Recognized as India's 100th Unicorn, OPEN was awarded ‘Best Workplace 2024’ by IEEE and has been featured among the 'Top 10 companies' by Forbes India and D Globalist's list of 200, and in IDFC FIRST Private Hurun India's Top 200 Self-made Entrepreneurs of the Millennia 2023. nearMatches.title: Sales Engineer
nearMatches.text:
About Us

Orkes is a foundational platform for rapidly building and modernizing enterprise grade applications. Our platform offers the unique blend of Business Process Workflow Orchestration, API Management, Configurable Integration Management and Agentic Workflows. These capabilities have helped development teams to abstract the complexities involved in modern application development , move away from legacy solutions and focus on applying their capabilities into building revenue generating code for their businesses. Orkes lets developers focus on faster go to market with applications, scaling them to handle billions of workflows without having to worry about failures, scalability or visibility into the executions.

We are seeking a Sales Engineer to join our dynamic team at Orkes. As a key member of the sales team, you will bridge the gap between technical expertise and business value, helping prospective customers understand how Orkes can solve their challenges. This role is ideal for a technical professional with a passion for problem-solving, customer interaction, and influencing business decisions through technical insight.

Your day-to-day at Orkes:

  • Solution Expertise: Gain a deep understanding of Orkes' platform, architecture, and capabilities to act as a subject matter expert.
  • Customer Engagement: Partner with sales representatives to engage with prospects, assess their needs, and provide tailored demonstrations of Orkes solutions.
  • Technical Presentations: Lead compelling presentations, technical deep-dives, and proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to showcase the value of Orkes to diverse stakeholders.
  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers to understand their technical requirements and design effective solutions leveraging Orkes' platform.
  • Solution Design: Partner with Orkes’ product and engineering team to map customer requirements and own rapid buildout of compelling solution demonstrations to showcase Orkes’ value proposition to customer
  • Customer RFI and RFP support: Partner with sales executives, marketing and product teams to own the timely completion of Orkes’ winning response to customer RFIs and RFPs
  • Feedback Loop: Act as a voice of the customer, providing feedback to product and engineering teams to influence the product roadmap.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with sales, customer support, product, and engineering teams to drive deals to closure and ensure customer success.
  • Training & Enablement: Drive customer training of Orkes platform, offering best practices and guidance on optimizing customer workflow development by leveraging latest capabilities such as GenAI and Advanced Human-Tasks

Qualities that will help you succeed: 

  • Proven experience in a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js).
  • Experience with orchestration tools, workflow engines, or similar technologies is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent in mapping customer requirements to rapidly visualize compelling solutions leveraging Orkes’ platform capabilities
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Hands-on experience with Workflow development and APIs
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Prior experience working with open-source software or communities.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and system integrations. 

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

More Details:

  • Start Date: As soon as possible
  • Status: Full Time 
  • Type: Remote
  • Location: London, England
  • Department: Sales
  • Reports to: Head of Sales Engineering
  • Travel: 50%

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision
  • Flexible PTO
  • Support for personal development

At Orkes, we are committed to building a team that reflects a rich tapestry of perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We believe that diversity is not just a checkbox, but a driving force behind innovation, creativity, and success. By embracing a variety of backgrounds, we cultivate an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. 

Join us at Orkes and be a part of a team where your unique perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Together we are shaping the future technology by leveraging the strength that comes from embracing diversity in all its forms. Your Journey with us is an opportunity to contribute to something greater and make a lasting impact.

matches.text: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com. Job Summary OpenGov’s Professional Services (PS) team is expanding its AI capabilities to accelerate product implementations, streamline customer workflows, and deliver transformative efficiencies to state and local governments. As 'AI Developer II', you will split your time between: - Building AI agents, tools, automations, and reusable PS assets, and - Building custom software features and solutions that bridge product gaps and accelerate customer go-live - Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to configure, deploy, and optimize AI-driven workflows - Collaborating with Product Managers and Product Architects to ensure customizations are scalable, maintainable, and eligible for inclusion in the core product This role is ideal for a technical builder who is equally comfortable writing code, engineering custom features, understanding government business processes, collaborating cross-functionally, and supporting delivery teams with AI and integration expertise. You will help define OpenGov’s standards for AI-enabled implementations and shape how our PS organization scales using AI-first practices. Key Responsibilities 1. AI Capabilities & Agent Development - Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents, automations, prompts, retrieval systems, and workflow utilities that accelerate implementation timelines and reduce manual effort. - Apply modern agent architectures and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, MCPs, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) to deliver reliable, production-grade solutions. - Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks, observability, and versioning to ensure safe, consistent, auditable agent performance. - Maintain reusable libraries, templates, and modules that PS consultants can configure independently. 2. Custom Feature & Solution Development - Design and develop custom software features or product extensions required during customer implementations, bridging gaps between out-of-the-box product capabilities and customer-specific business requirements. - Collaborate with Implementation Consultants and Project Managers to assess, scope, and deliver custom solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with OpenGov's product architecture and security standards. - Build, test, and deploy configuration scripts, data transformation utilities, custom reports, and workflow extensions using the OpenGov technology stack, ensuring each deliverable meets quality, performance, and compliance standards. - Identify opportunities to convert one-off custom solutions into reusable PS accelerators, contributing to a shared library of implementation assets that reduce delivery time across future engagements. 3. Inter Suite Operability and Integrations - Serve as the technical owner responsible for designing, building, testing, and deploying robust integrations between our product suites and/or customer owned / third-party enterprise systems. The ultimate goal is to optimize complex end-to-end business workflows and maximize operational efficiency for the customer. - Select, implement, and maintain the most appropriate and high-performing integration patterns (like API Driven, Event Driven, File Based, Batch Triggers etc) based on data volume, velocity, and customer infrastructure limitations - Ensure all implemented integration points adhere to strict enterprise security standards and maintain high performance and low latency. - Proactively identify common integration requirements across multiple implementations (e.g., common ERP connectors, standard transformation logic); design, create, and rigorously maintain high-quality, reusable code artifacts and integration templates. - Build these reusable assets to be configurable, allowing Professional Services consultants to deploy them for new clients with no-to-minimal customization. - Produce comprehensive technical documentation, including data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and deployment guides for all integration patterns, ensuring the knowledge is easily transferable and maintainable by the wider PS team. 4. Embedded Delivery Support - Serve as an embedded AI specialist within active customer implementations, partnering with Project Managers, Implementation Engineers to design AI-driven processes. - Translate business workflows into automated AI solutions. - Configure AI-enhanced features within OpenGov products based on customer requirements, data, and local/state government context. - Troubleshoot and optimize agent behavior for real-world customer scenarios. 5. Workflow Optimization & Scale - Identify patterns in implementation activities where AI can reduce effort, accelerate delivery, or improve quality. - Build internal tools that improve implementation repeatability, cross-team collaboration, and operational scalability. - Analyze logs, data flows, and performance metrics to iteratively improve reliability and efficiency. 6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Evangelism - Work closely with R&D, Implementation Engineers, Customer Success, Field Enablement, and Product Management to align AI capabilities with broader OpenGov strategy. - Provide product feedback based on customer interactions and implementation learnings. - Enable PS colleagues through documentation, training, and best-practice AI usage guidelines. - Help customers understand the value of AI features and drive adoption of new capabilities. 7. Project & Delivery Management - Contribute technical effort estimates and assist with implementation planning where AI components are required. - Manage work across multiple concurrent engagements while maintaining high standards of quality and responsiveness. - Ensure timely delivery of AI components within broader PS project timelines. Required Qualifications - 3+ years of experience designing or implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, or data-driven insights. - 1+ years hands-on experience building AI agents or orchestration workflows using modern frameworks and model APIs. - 2+ years of experience building custom software features or product extensions in a SaaS or services delivery context, including requirements scoping, development, testing, and handover documentation. - 2+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise application integration (EAI) in a Professional Services or consulting setting. - Strong proficiency with LLM prompt engineering, retrieval/RAG architectures, vector stores, evaluation methods, and safety/guardrail patterns. - Working knowledge of AI tools and standards such as MCP-based architectures, LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. - Experience integrating third-party AI APIs and embedding LLM outputs into larger application workflows. - Technical fluency in at least one programming language like Python, JavaScript or Java with ability to write maintainable, modular code. - Proficiency in designing and developing integrations using REST / SOAP APIs, File Based data exchanges, Event Based triggers (Webhook, Kafka etc) and protocols. Strong understanding of security standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI). - Ability to map complex business processes into structured workflows and automated solutions. - Proven success working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical audiences. - Strong analytical thinking with systems, data, and process-improvement mindset. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in GovTech, public-sector workflows, budgeting, permitting, procurement, or financial management. - Familiarity with responsible AI practices, privacy considerations, and compliance requirements applicable to government customers. - Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles. - Experience building reusable tooling or platform capabilities for services teams. Success Metrics (Examples) Within 6–12 months, success may include: - Reduction of implementation hours by 20–40% through AI tooling and workflow improvements. - Delivery of 3–5 reusable AI modules, custom features, integrations or templates adopted across PS engagements. - Demonstrated improvement in agent reliability through evaluation scores, logs, and documented refinements. - Positive impact on implementation timelines, customer satisfaction, and cross-team efficiency. - Increased adoption of AI features across customer implementations. Why Join OpenGov Professional Services You will be on the front line of transforming how governments deploy technology by embedding AI deeply into their operational workflows. As part of our PS team, you will: - Shape the future of AI-enabled implementations at scale. - Work with a mission-driven team focused on real-world government impact. - Build modern AI capabilities while seeing them applied directly to customer transformation. - Influence product direction, implementation design, and the evolution of OpenGov’s AI-first services model. WHY OPENGOV? A Mission That Matters. At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. Opportunity to Innovate The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. A Team of Passionate, Driven People This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. A Place to Make Your Mark We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. Benefits That Work for You Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays - 401(k) with company match - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions - Professional development and growth opportunities - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

closest.title: Junior Engineer, Quality
closest.text: Job Description: In-Process Quality Assurance (IPQA) - Conduct stage-wise inspections during system assembly and MEA manufacturing processes. - Verify compliance with approved drawings, BOM, SOPs, work instructions, and control plans. - Monitor critical process parameters and ensure adherence to defined quality gates. - Perform first article inspection (FAI) / initial sample inspection. - Identify, document, and escalate deviations, defects, and non-conformities. - Ensure proper implementation of in-process checks by production teams. - Support line clearance activities and changeover validations. Final Quality Assurance (FQA) - Perform final inspection of finished systems and MEA assemblies before FG release. - Verify product configuration, labeling, packaging, and documentation completeness. - Ensure product meets customer specifications and regulatory requirements. - Conduct functional testing / verification as applicable. - Ensure correct serialization, traceability, and batch control. Build-to-Finished Goods to-Shipment Control - Validate product quality from manufacturing completion to FG stage. - Ensure all inspection and test records are complete and approved. - Review and authorize OK-to-Shipment based on compliance. - Coordinate with warehouse/logistics for release of conforming products only. - Prevent shipment of non-conforming or unverified products. Non-Conformance Management - Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and track closure. - Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). - Implement containment actions for defective lots. - Support MRB (Material Review Board) activities. Documentation & Compliance - Maintain inspection records, checklists, and quality reports. - Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 / applicable QMS standards. - Support internal and external audits. Continuous Improvement - Identify quality improvement opportunities in processes. - D efect reduction initiatives. - Analyze quality data and drive trend-based improvements. Cross-functional Coordination - Work closely with Production, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams. - Liaise with suppliers and customers on quality-related issues. - Provide feedback on process improvements. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED: Diploma / bachelor’s degree in mechanical / electrical / Electronics / Industrial Engineering or related field with 2–3 years of experience in Quality Assurance in manufacturing environment is desired. Strong knowledge of inspection techniques and quality tools. Familiarity with GD&T, drawings, and technical specifications. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and QMS practices. Good understanding of manufacturing processes and control plans. Proficiency in measurement tools and testing equipment. OHMIUM CULTURE: At Ohmium, you are expected to embody and champion our core cultural values: Accountability : I own my tasks and execute on time . Demonstrate strong accountability by owning deliverables and decisions, ensuring timely and consistent results. Teamwork : I will not let other teams fail. Takes ownership beyond own team to support cross-team success and prevent failures, thereby fostering a collaborative work environment. Learning Mindset : I drive change and learn from mistakes. Exhibits a strong growth mindset by proactively leading meaningful change and consistently learning from experience. Winning Attitude : I compete to win. Showing up every day with a strong perspective, to drive results and be the BEST in Green Energy. To ensure in-process and final quality of System Manufacturing products from build-to-Finished goods-to-Shipment by implementing robust inspection processes, adherence to quality standards, and effective containment of non-conformities. Ohmium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
